name: Sahel insurgency
summary: JNIM fuel blockade on Bamako persists; insurgency pressing toward Guinea
state: JNIM's fuel blockade of Mali's capital, imposed in September 2025 and declared total on 28 Apr 2026, was last reported in force with Bamako relying on escorted convoys; no report of it being lifted was found as of 1 Nov. Mali air strikes reportedly killed 89 civilians on 19 Oct, and JNIM is expanding toward Guinea.
for_you: Follow FCDO advice against all travel to most of Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger.
rubric_hit: Blockade or fall of a capital or major city, or mass-casualty attacks spreading to coastal states.

sources.title: The OpsCon — Bamako still moves on escorted fuel convoys

why: Jihadist groups control growing territory across Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger, driving displacement and coastal-state spillover.
drivers: JNIM/IS-Sahel offensives, juntas, Russian forces, blockades, coastal-state attacks.
